description: Defines a PHP class 'AttributeBag' used for managing a collection of parameters with methods for adding, removing, and accessing parameters. Implements IteratorAggregate and Countable interfaces for iteration and counting functionalities.

classes.name: AttributeBag
classes.description: A class providing a container for key-value parameters with utility methods for modification and access, supporting iteration and counting.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the AttributeBag with optional parameters provided as an array.

methods.name: all
methods.description: Returns all parameters as an array.

methods.name: keys
methods.description: Returns the keys of all parameters.

methods.name: replace
methods.description: Replaces all existing parameters with a new array.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Merges new parameters into the existing parameter set.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves the value associated with a key, or default if key does not exist.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets a value for a specific key.

methods.name: has
methods.description: Checks if a key exists in the parameters.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a key and its associated value.

methods.name: getIterator
methods.description: Returns an iterator for the parameters, enabling foreach iteration.
